title: Design Pipeline Tunables
description: tunables.json: what an owner may change in a film or a page without editing code. params are Playground controls (same vocabulary) plus unit, window and dynamic; values holds only the owner's changes. tunables.js is generated from the effective values by `tunables sync`; never edit it.

values.description: id -> value for each param the owner changed; a value equal to its default is not stored. Each value must fit its param (checked by `tunables check`).

id.description: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, at most 64 characters. The id is the name in tunable("id"), --tn-<id>, data-tn-<id> and data-tn-text="id".

label.description: What the owner sees next to the control.

group.description: Controls with the same group share a fieldset in the panel.

unit.description: A label such as px, s or deg. A range param whose unit is a CSS unit (px rem em % s ms deg vw vh) gets that unit on its --tn-<id> custom property.

window.description: Seconds in which the param is visible on a timeline. The probe samples there and the panel seeks to its middle when the control is focused.

dynamic.description: true when the project reads the id with a name built at run time, so `check` does not report param-unread.
